title: A refused confirm's telemetry names one reason for several kinds of refusal
evidence: app/lib/mcp.server.ts checkConfirm returns distinct words for an invalid, expired or early receipt, a missing or over-long approval, a spent receipt and an unavailable store, but the mcp_tool_call product event records reason 'confirm' for all of them. Proposed: fixed content-free sub-reasons (confirm-early, confirm-expired, confirm-invalid, confirm-approval, confirm-spent, confirm-unavailable), with a failing test first that a refusal's row names its kind
